notes.title: DEV UPDATE #5
notes.content:
[h1]Work Work[/h1]
Oh boy, it's been a while since the last update! I hope you all have had a great holiday and that 2018 will be even more awesome than the previous year!

The biggest culprit for my absence is well, the above, and that I've been mostly working on "behind the scenes"-stuff, with that I mean, coding and world/level-design.

Some of the functions and features in Just Us have been in a prototype state, this is usually the initial state when working on something new for any game, you hack something together to see if it'll work, and to know if it's something you want to spend your time on.

After the hack-and-slash coding you begin refactoring the code, making it usable on a production level, now this, is where I've spent most of my time for the past few months.

Writing/Re-writing thousands and thousands of lines of c++ code takes a while, so please bare with me :)

With that said, I do have some visual updates for you!

[h1]Structural integrity[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30499796/2461843919c1b3dbe805db5fcf3dff3c2cfc1c00.jpg[/img]

This is a new feature that I announced today, I wasn't going to include any "advanced" structural integrity for buildings, but I decided to hack something together and see the result, I'm pretty happy with it and I hope that you like it too, as always, I'm happy to receive your feedback! [b]Please note, this is still a work in progress![/b]

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=attj1ZVZGGU[/url]

[h1]The feature that no one asked for[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30499796/0015c5e07ae6471afaa4753433b3af58d8dfe475.png[/img]

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yVZ5jEjmEO8[/url]

I'll let the video speak for itself ;)


[h1]If you want to stay up to date with my progress and development, check out my twitter & facebook![/h1]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/justusgame/]https://www.facebook.com/justusgame/[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/dryeeldev]https://twitter.com/dryeeldev[/url]
[url]https://justusgame.com[/url]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #3
notes.content:
Time for a new dev update for you all!

[h1]Horse Armor & Equipment![/h1]
Introducing Horse Armor & Equipment!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30499796/8f4a34476a5b0d62407c98c415b3d9b14e674439.jpg[/img]

This time, I'm introducing you to 2 new unannounced features that I've been working on, and I'm quite excited for both!

Down below I'm showcasing a quick demo of a work in progress system for your horse! Which will enable you to craft horse armor & equipment to better protect your horse(s). 

As an example, you'll be able to craft bags and equip them on your horse to store items & equip them with different tiers of armor for better protection against enemies & weather. There are however, some drawbacks while doing so, more details on this later

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fsXDuCRtDD4]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fsXDuCRtDD4[/url]

[h1]GRINDING STONES[/h1]
I'm happy to announce less garbage collection!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30499796/9a48c86cce7778f781fb71241c83f455604a8e9f.jpg[/img]

The grinding stone is a machinery you can craft and place in the world that will allow you to grind/sharpen tools, weapons and even ammo!

An example is sharpening arrows to increase their damage slightly, or if you have a worn down axe, you can use this tool to increase it's quality again! 

I will introduce you to other methods of repairing stuff at a later date, but for now, this will have to do :)

[h1]If you want to stay up to date with my progress and development, check out my twitter & facebook![/h1]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/justusgame/]https://www.facebook.com/justusgame/[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/dryeeldev]https://twitter.com/dryeeldev[/url]
[url]https://justusgame.com[/url]

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #2
notes.content:
It's been a long time since I made a dev update, but I'm always extremely busy I sometimes forget to update all the social medias.

The latest news is that I just recently released a new gameplay video, featuring the Zombies game mode!

I know there are a lot of mixed feelings when it comes to zombies, you either hate them, or you love them, this is why I've made this game mode OPTIONAL. If you like Zombies, you can have them, if not, I'm not going to force them onto you.

Zombies are not part of the main game/the story, but when I asked my followers if they would like to see a separate Zombie game mode, the results were in the likes of 70% yes, 30% no. 

Zombie mechanics are quite easy to make, so why not? Personally, I don't mind them. But I also didn't want to make another zombie game.

The video is available on youtube, check it out!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIxdFwtsW2A]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xIxdFwtsW2A[/url]
